raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The 2026-01-17 v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions stores txn_ts unconverted. The v2 rows that look like 00:00-06:00 on 2026-01-19 are UTC timestamps that are really 18:00-24:00 Chicago time on 2026-01-18, so they are misdated and misplaced in time. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago in silver_transactions fixes txn_ts and txn_date while keeping the schema and the other steps unchanged.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN (CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AT TIME ZONE 'America/Chicago' ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
